purpose: Identify source licensing and provide a reproducible path to acquire authentic lexeme sources for Nirgundi.
reason_not_bundled: The execution environment could verify source pages but could not retrieve third-party source files into the working filesystem. The package does not misrepresent link-only sources as downloaded datasets.

sources.title: Nighaṇṭu: First XML edition
sources.redistribution_decision: Do not bundle until the source XML is acquired and the CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 attribution/share-alike obligations are handled. Commercial use is not permitted by this licence.

sources.evidence: The catalogue page states the title, editor/contributor, version, publication, copyright, and CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 terms.

sources.title: Monier-Williams dictionary source text (CDSL csl-orig)
sources.redistribution_decision: Download and redistribute with attribution and licence. Preserve source identity and ShareAlike obligations for adapted material.
sources.required_attribution: Cologne Digital Sanskrit Dictionaries (CDSL), csl-orig, Monier-Williams source text, accessed 2026-10-09. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
sources.notes: The repository describes canonical source text files as UTF-8, SLP1, with one dictionary entry record wrapped in markup. This is dictionary data, not a traditional enumerated lexeme list.
